listing.title: Set a freelance day rate above your floor
listing.outcome: A day rate to propose, the project fee it gives, two scope terms and a reply you can send to the client.
listing.urgency: The client wants your rate today, and if your floor rate leaks it becomes the price.
limits: Day rates only, not monthly salaries
listing.sample_output: Synthetic example: propose IDR 4,200,000 per day for 10 days (IDR 42,000,000), ask for 50% upfront and a 2 round revision limit.

fields.label: Lowest day rate you would accept
Typical day rate for this work
Client type
fields.help: For example startup, agency or enterprise.

steps.what: Send the sealed method and your data to the private model and check its attestation and signature
Withhold the answer if it repeats the seller's method text

buyer_checks.description: The model answered in the promised format
buyer_checks.pass_message: The model answered in the promised format.
buyer_checks.message: The model's answer is not in the promised JSON format, so nothing else can be checked.

buyer_checks.description: The proposed day rate is at least your floor rate
buyer_checks.pass_message: The proposed rate of {{answer.proposed_rate:int}} per day is at or above your floor rate.
buyer_checks.message: The proposed rate of {{answer.proposed_rate:int}} per day is below your floor rate. Do not send it.

buyer_checks.description: The proposed day rate is not below what the client already offered
buyer_checks.pass_message: The proposed rate is not below the client's offer.
buyer_checks.message: The proposed rate is below the client's own offer, so it gives money away.

buyer_checks.description: The proposed day rate is at most 60% above the higher of the offer and your floor
buyer_checks.pass_message: The proposed rate stays within the 60% cap the method promises.
buyer_checks.message: The proposed rate is more than 60% above the higher of the offer and your floor, which the method says it caps.

buyer_checks.description: The project fee equals the day rate times the estimated days
buyer_checks.pass_message: The project fee of {{answer.project_fee:int}} equals the day rate times {{input.days}} days.
buyer_checks.message: The project fee of {{answer.project_fee:int}} is not the day rate times {{input.days}} days.

buyer_checks.description: The reply does not reveal your floor rate
buyer_checks.pass_message: The reply does not contain your floor rate.
buyer_checks.message: The reply contains your floor rate. Do not send it.

buyer_checks.description: Exactly two scope or payment terms
buyer_checks.pass_message: The answer has two scope or payment terms.
buyer_checks.message: The answer does not have exactly two scope or payment terms.

disclosures: This method is a prompt. The answer comes from an AI model, so the same data can give a different answer.
The runner cannot prove the model followed every rule. Check the numbers yourself.
Checks cover your floor, the offer, the cap and the fee arithmetic only. They cannot judge whether the client will accept.

runtime.runner: platform runner, prompt method: the runner sends the sealed seller prompt and your data to one private model
